from.place: Proof paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction before the displayed derived inverse limit; flat model recognition infrastructure, via lem-coef-sheaf-flat-model. Small object factorizations for a set in a locally presentable category. Input to the small object argument: Every object of a locally presentable category has a presentability rank.

title: Every object of a locally presentable category has a presentability rank
statement: Let $\mathcal U$ be a universe and $\mathcal C$ a category with $\mathcal U$-small Hom sets and all $\mathcal U$-small colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Suppose there is an infinite regular cardinal $\kappa\in\mathcal U$ and a $\mathcal U$-small family of objects $G$ such that each $\operatorname{Hom}(G,-)$ preserves $\mathcal U$-small $\kappa$-filtered colimits and every object is such a colimit of members of the family. Then for every object $A$ there exists an infinite regular cardinal $\tau_A\in\mathcal U$ such that $\operatorname{Hom}(A,-)$ preserves every $\mathcal U$-small $\tau_A$-filtered colimit. Here $\rho$-filtered means every diagram with fewer than $\rho$ morphisms admits a cocone; infinite regular means that a union of fewer than $\rho$ sets of cardinality less than $\rho$ still has cardinality less than $\rho$.
